summary: Learn to govern and validate credit, fraud and AML models with practical tests, inventory controls and audit-ready documentation. Explore the course.
lede: AI model risk governance training helps risk managers, validators, auditors and compliance professionals assess and oversee credit and financial crime models. You’ll build risk-tiered inventories, review lifecycle controls, calculate credit-model measures such as Gini and PSI, and create testing plans for fraud and anti-money-laundering monitoring. Exercises also cover documentation, audit evidence, issue escalation and ongoing monitoring; advanced AI-risk topics are treated conceptually rather than as technical model-building.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess, operate, oversee or audit credit and financial crime models in financial institutions and supervisory settings.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of credit risk, model development or validation, fraud analytics, AML monitoring, internal audit or compliance is expected. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with access to Excel for spreadsheet-based exercises; advanced AI risk concepts receive conceptual or operational treatment rather than technical implementation.
